statements.quote: However, given the operating leverage and pricing power inherent in the business, we are raising our long-term target for the Siding EBITDA margin by 5 percentage points to 25%.

statements.quote: As a result of this growth, Siding achieved our long-term EBITDA margin target of 25% for the full year despite a soft market in OSB.
statements.speaker: Brad Southern

statements.quote: Despite ongoing headwinds from raw material inflation, we anticipate Siding EBITDA in the third quarter of between $110 million and $120 million, for an EBITDA margin of about 25%.
statements.speaker: Aaron Howald

statements.quote: LP has no control over OSB prices, obviously, but we are aggressively pursuing opportunities to improve cost and efficiency while protecting our assets
statements.speaker: Aaron Howald

street.source: Baba data_financials consensus (consolidated; no Siding segment consensus pulled)

evidence_of_progress.note: Consolidated EBITDA margin: Q1 2026 82/574 vs Q1 2025 162/724; Q2 2026 79/664 (CEO, Q2 2026 call, doc 129684) vs Q2 2025 142/755 (consensus actuals). Declines driven by OSB prices; Siding margin held at 26% in Q2 2026 and 28% in Q1 2026 (CFO, doc 154888). Siding has met its 25% target since FY2024, so there is no unmet margin target to close.

disqualifier_reason: Consolidated margin is commodity-price driven: OSB EBITDA guided to about -$120M for FY2026 at flat prices (Q2 2026 call, doc 129684), and the -27% 12-month EBITDA revision reflects OSB. The only numeric margin target (Siding 25%, set Feb 2021, no year) has already been achieved since FY2024 (26% in FY2025), so there is no unproven gap to close.
verdict: Not a GXO setup: leadership turnover is all internal succession, the only margin target (Siding 25%) is already met, and consolidated margin moves with OSB prices.
open_questions: Will Ringblom or Howald set a new Siding margin target above 25%, or a consolidated target that excludes OSB, at the next Investor Day?
How much of the -27% FY2027 consensus EBITDA revision is OSB price versus Siding volume?
Does the 2026 to 2027 ExpertFinish capacity build (Green Bay, Bath, North Branch) dilute Siding margin during ramp?
